claim: In the HWA laboratory, the WSL host is DESKTOP-298GT47.localdomain, while MDMHOST is an intentional /etc/hosts alias resolving to 127.0.0.1 and is consistently used by the MDM workstation NODE and direct ResourceAdvisorUrl. source_url: local hostname, Composer and JobManager.ini inspection
